messages.subject: Themes for facet annotations
parts:
I've looked at p. 143 of the book looking for how to control the font
of the Y scale labels for a set of facets , and also for the
facet-title. I've tried various without success. Does anyone know which
theme/element is involved?

messages.author: cd9baedf48d871eb
messages.subject: Re: Themes for facet annotations
parts:
Do you want something like this (admittedly ugly, but shows various
possibilities of tweaking)?

d <- data.frame(f=rep(c("a","b"), each=5), x_var=rnorm(10), y_var=rnorm
(10) )
p <- qplot(x_var,y_var, data=d, facets=~f)
p

theme_update( axis.title.y=theme_text(family="serif", angle=90,
face="bold", size=16))
theme_update( axis.text.y=theme_text(colour="red", hjust=1))
theme_update( strip.text.x=theme_text(family="serif", colour="green",
face="bold", size=16))
p
